# x402 PII Redactor

> Fast, deterministic PII scrubbing for AI agents. Pay per call with x402 / USDC on Base.

## Free Discovery
- GET /catalog – machine-readable list of services + prices
- GET /api/redact – returns service metadata (no payment)

## Paid Endpoint
- POST /api/redact
  - Body: { "text": "string", "options"?: { "maskChar": "*" } }
  - Returns: { "redacted": "...", "stats": { "email": n, ... } }
  - Price: ~0.01 USDC (configurable)

## Payment
Uses standard x402 flow. Server returns 402 + PAYMENT-REQUIRED header.
Retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE.

## Why agents use this
Clean logs, protect user data before calling other tools, reduce compliance risk.
